{{Top|leg}}
The '''Red Skulls''' were a group of [[Pirate/Legends|space pirates]] active in the [[Endor system/Legends|Endor system]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. In space battles, the pirates flew [[M3-A Scyk interceptor/Legends|M3-A Scyk fighters]].<ref name="SWG:JtL">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed]]''</ref>
{{Company-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Red Skulls appeared appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:JtL" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Red Skulls were added to the game with the release of the expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed|''Jump to Lightspeed'']] on [[October 27]], [[2004]].<ref name="SWG:JtL" />
